name: ConformEval
description: ConformEval (Protein Conformation Evaluation Benchmark) evaluates protein language model representations on protein knot detection, fold-switch ranking, and residue-level disorder prediction. The dataset provides protein sequences, reference labels, and cross-validation splits for the three tasks. Model adapters, representation extraction, predictor training, and scoring tools are available in the code repository. Code: https://github.com/wyqmath/ConformEval
